purpose: Show that every claim in this bundle reconstructs from a clean clone at an immutable commit, and that at least one replay ran on an instrument that is not the producing run.

replays.instrument: throwaway clean clone from the remote inside the orchestrator VM

results.scctl validate: PASS: SCF-01 seed contracts and state invariants

replays.independence_argument: A different machine, a different operating-system image and a different identity, with no access to this orchestrator's filesystem, memory or provider session. It re-derived every hash from a fresh checkout.

steps.name: Replay the route qualification evidence from this clean clone

replays.significance: The route qualification evidence was re-verified end to end by an instrument the producing run does not control. This is corroboration, not acceptance; it does not substitute for the independent acceptance record.
Repository-wide operator taxonomy currentness still passes after this branch's writes.

ci_result_retrieval_route.addressing_scheme: immutable commit SHA -> check runs, and workflow run id -> job id -> step conclusions
ci_result_retrieval_route.delivery_independence_note: The result was retrieved by addressing the immutable commit directly, so it does not depend on an event being delivered. A push-delivery subscription was also created; its documented drop condition is that results for a commit superseded by a newer push are discarded, which is exactly why the addressable retrieval is the primary path and the subscription is the convenience path.

fallback_exercises.injected: check-runs retrieval for commit 04001dba1c689c90041ea383f3092213756c7ead, which had no CI run
fallback_exercises.observed: total_count=0 and zero check runs returned; the absence of a run is not reported as a pass

fallback_exercises.injected: check-runs retrieval for an all-zero SHA
fallback_exercises.observed: HTTP 422 'No commit found for SHA'; no result fabricated

why_r3_is_still_not_counted_as_qualified: R3 now has bounded launch, addressable retrieval, a stable locator, reconciliation into repository custody and two fail-closed fallbacks. It lacks only its own remote byte-for-byte read-back, which would require a further commit whose read-back would in turn require another. R3 is therefore recorded honestly as AVAILABLE_NOT_QUALIFIED rather than padded into the count. The qualification already passes on two routes without it.
